## `neuro.int32Array.forEach`

Instance method on `Int32Array.prototype`.

> Performs the specified action for each element in an array.

## Signatures

```ts
forEach(input: { int32Array: <receiver>; callbackfn?: (value: number; index: number; array: Int32Array) => void; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<void>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Int32Array.prototype.forEach` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
